papers.title: Hydrogel-confined environment for aqueous-compatible perovskite crystallization
papers.summary: Halide perovskite synthesis generally uses toxic, high-boiling-point and strongly coordinating organic solvents, hindering scalable processing and crystallographic control in thick-film applications. Water is ideal as a solvent but incompatible with perovskite synthesis due to precursor insolubility and rapid hydrolysis in water. Here we introduce a hydrogel-confined reaction environment that overcomes this incompatibility by decoupling precursor solvation from lattice formation. Within a polymer–water network, PbI2 and organic iodides are dispersed in a stabilized ionic state that suppresses aggregation and kinetically inhibits water-induced decomposition. Concurrently, this network anchors emerging nuclei and imposes spatial confinement, directing crystal growth into dense thick films. Spectroscopic and computational analysis reveals facet-specific coordination between polymer and perovskite, suppressing surface defect formation and preserving efficient charge transport despite the presence of the polymer matrix. The resultant thick hydrogel-grown films (180 µm) exhibit charge carrier mobilities of ∼10 cm2 V−1 s−1. When directly integrated into pixelated X-ray imaging sensors, the device achieves a high sensitivity-to-noise ratio of \(25,000\,\upmu {\text{C}}\,{{\text{Gy}}}_{{\text{air}}}^{-1}\,{{\text{cm}}}^{-2}\,{{\text{pA}}}^{-1}\), with an ultralow detection limit of 19.8 nGyair s−1, enabling high-fidelity imaging with negligible signal crosstalk.

papers.title: Hidden reaction pathways inform additive engineering for perovskite LEDs
papers.summary: Perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) have emerged as a promising class of solution-processed light-emitting devices, combining high efficiency with facile fabrication1,2,3,4,5. Amino-acid-based molecular additives are widely used to regulate crystallization and suppress defects in perovskite thin films6,7,8, yet these molecules are chemically reactive in precursor solutions, in which their transformations and products remain poorly understood. Here we resolve and control the hidden solution-phase chemistry of a ubiquitous additive, 5-aminovaleric acid (5AVA), whose solution-phase reactivity has remained unclear6,9,10,11,12,13,14,15. We show that 5AVA undergoes competing in situ reactions during precursor preconditioning, yielding two chemically and functionally distinct products: a beneficial organoamidinium zwitterion and a detrimental Lewis-base lactam. By explaining this reaction dichotomy and establishing targeted reaction-pathway control, we selectively use the beneficial species. Direct synthesis and incorporation of the purified zwitterion decouple its intrinsic passivation function from confounding by-products, yielding perovskite films with a near-unity mean peak photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 97.2% and PeLEDs with a champion external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 37.1%, alongside a mean peak EQE of 32.8%. Finally, we demonstrate that this reaction-pathway control concept can be extended to further additive chemistries and emission colours, highlighting its potential as a chemistry-driven strategy for rational additive design in PeLEDs.

机理上，该分子调控界面能级与结晶动力学，实现相分布均一化并降低界面缺陷密度。

器件外量子效率与光谱稳定性较同类天蓝器件显著提升，且蓝光色纯度改善。

该策略为埋底界面相工程提供了可推广的分子设计范式，推动了高效稳定天蓝钙钛矿LED的发展。

该工作针对钙钛矿太阳能电池中镍基空穴传输层（如NiOx）依赖稀缺金属、界面能级失配及器件回收困难的技术瓶颈，提出以自组装单分子层（SAMs）完全替代镍基空穴传输材料的无镍器件架构。

其创新在于通过分子锚定基团与透明导电衬底的化学键合构建超薄空穴选择性接触，并系统调控SAMs末端官能团以优化界面偶极与能级对齐。

机理研究表明，SAMs单分子层可有效钝化钙钛矿埋底界面缺陷、抑制非辐射复合，同时其可溶性特征赋予器件温和条件下解离回收的能力。

所制备无镍器件效率达到与镍基对照器件相当甚至更优的水平，且循环回收后效率保持率显著提升。

该策略为钙钛矿光伏摆脱关键金属依赖、实现可持续制造与闭环回收提供了可扩展的材料界面设计范式。
